OUR LITTLE WORLD

Home should feel like you.

LUMIÉA is a dreamy little home-decor shop built around the idea that the smallest details can change the feeling of a room. We curate playful lighting, floral pieces, cute organizers and everyday finds that make your space feel warmer, softer and more you.

FAQ

Good to know.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery time varies by product and destination. The final estimated delivery window should be confirmed before purchase.

Are the prices final?

Not yet. Product prices are marked “Price TBD” until supplier cost, shipping, payment fees and your target margin are verified.

What if my order arrives damaged?

Contact LUMIÉA promptly with your order number and clear photos/video of the issue so we can review it.

Are the photos ready for commercial use?

These are the product inspiration photos supplied in this conversation. Before selling, confirm that the matching supplier listing provides commercial-use product media or replace the images with supplier-approved media.
